## Implemented

**Task 8 (S7a.2)** in `crates/bridge-a2a-inbound/src/server.rs` — the merged seq-ordered snapshot projection.

- `fold_or_typed_snapshot` now returns a new `FoldedSnapshot { snap, events }` struct from the ONE `journal_fold_inputs` read (previously discarded `events`).
- Added `rich_snapshot_frames(snap, events, cursor)`: merges `snapshot_frames(snap, None)` (node frames) with `fold_rich_frames(events)` (folded rich frames), sorts by seq, then cursor-filters ONCE.
- Added `fold_rich_frames(events)`: folds `Plan` (latest-only), and `ToolCall`/`ToolCallUpdate` per `tool_call_id` (full `ToolCall` sets/replaces base; `ToolCallUpdate` sparsely patches present fields) — emits one `FrameKind::ToolCall` at the last-applied seq if a base existed, else an orphan `FrameKind::ToolCallUpdate`. Reuses `reattach::frame_from_orch` for both.
- Swapped both reattach call sites — `terminal_sse_response` (now takes `events: &[OrchEvent]`) and `working_sse_response`'s snapshot phase — to `rich_snapshot_frames`. The `SnapshotComplete` sentinel and `dedup_floor`/`cut_seq` logic are unchanged (they already derive from the frame list / `folded.snap`).
- Removed the Task-7-scoped `#[allow(dead_code)]` on `FrameKind::{Plan,ToolCall,ToolCallUpdate}` and `frame_from_orch` in `reattach.rs`, now that they're used.
